definition: Loss of electrons, or an increase in oxidation state; in many reactions it is also seen as gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.
Gain of electrons, or a decrease in oxidation state; in many reactions it is also seen as loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.
A species that oxidizes another by accepting its electrons, and so is itself reduced.
A species that reduces another by giving it electrons, and so is itself oxidized.
An equation for only the oxidation or only the reduction part of a redox reaction, showing the electrons lost or gained as $\ce{e-}$.
